title: National Workers Rally and anti-amendment march at Hibiya

state_targeted_demand.value: Public policy demands include opposition to constitutional amendment/war and criticism of Suga administration; labor rights claims also reported.

episode_and_continuity.value: Annual rally (23rd year per account); distinct 2020 occurrence; adjacent campaign continuity not fully checked.
